notes: Official mip360 protocol: images/ PIL-resized to width 1600 (-r -1), llffhold 8, 40k iterations (train.sh iterations=40_000; plugin total_steps=40000 -> pass --steps 40000). Required: --recipe 3dgs, --num-gaussians > SfM size (bench defaults). Compare per scene with paper_results.json mipnerf360.method (supp. tables, Our-Scaffold-GS): garden 27.67 / #GS 1475k, counter 30.19 / #GS 409k; paper 3D-GS row garden 27.45, counter 29.22 (authors' 40k retrain). In-house baseline: baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-1600-30000 (garden 26.93, counter 29.04; 30k steps). After each run: tools/ssenv python reproductions/octree-gs/plugin/report_counts.py <run> -> <run>/octree_gs_counts.json (anchors per level, rendered Gaussians per view = paper #GS(k), FPS).
